name: Tony Wong
intro: I make small, fast tools for Linux, local AI models, and voice input. Most of my code is Rust.
now: Voice input on Linux: tools that type dictated text on Wayland, and a signal on the screen when the microphone is on.
Ports of machine learning models to pure Rust, so that they operate without Python.
Learning Vim, one hint at a time.
ai: I write code with Claude Code. Several sessions work at the same time. Each session takes one task from a shared task board, and I examine the result before I accept it.
I operate small models on my own computer for dictation and for text classification. The data stays on the computer.
I use AI to read new open-source projects and tell me what they do, and to write documentation in plain English.
An agent does not publish, send, or delete without my approval.

blurbs.griffin_game: A web game about the Angel Problem of John Conway. Made at HackHarvard 2022.
